repos_data.description: A very simple no-fuss minimalist MCP Server with telephony tools like voice call and sms. This MCP Server can be integrated with LLM applications. Vonage API is used for calls, SMS, Speech-to-Text and Speech Recognition.
An ntfy MCP server for sending/fetching ntfy notifications to self-hosted or ANY ntfy.sh server from AI Agents 📤 (supports secure token auth & more - use with npx or docker!)
Local MCP voice coach with English pronunciation, grammar, and fluency feedback.
Callcenter.JS AI Voice Agent VOIP Connector, MCP + CLI
Natural voice conversations with Claude Code
MCP server for local speech translation (EN ↔ 中文) via Whisper + Claude + Piper

Talk to Claude Code instead of typing: a voice daemon + dashboard that records you, transcribes, routes to your agent sessions, and speaks the replies back - with per-voice avatars, push-to-talk hotkeys, and a live conversation HUD
Self-hosted market alerts (price, RSI, Pine Script v5) via push, email & Telegram — run TradingView-style alerts off-platform.
An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that lets you schedule AI phone calls and manage Leximo assignments directly from Claude Desktop or Claude Code — no app switching needed.

MCP server for Sats4AI — the permissionless communication supercharger for humans and AI agents. 40+ Lightning-paid tools: AI phone calls, voice in 602 languages, translation, fax, transcription, audiobooks, and more. No API keys, no KYC.

repo_meta_data.description: Let your AI agent call your phone and talk to you — MCP servers for live, interruptible voice calls + tiered alerts, using free self-hosted pieces (pjsua2 + whisper.cpp + Linphone). No paid telephony, no extra API key.
